description: Starts a machine in a run, the way deploys get theirs: the platform prepares it in the run's own network and security group, sized for the run (a machine is often already booted and waiting), and hands it over with your user_data as its setup: a #cloud-config with write_files and runcmd, or a script starting with #!, run as root. It is the only way a run gets machines. Read list_instances until it is ACTIVE; get_ssh_command gives SSH access. Billed hourly from the hand-over; end_run deletes it with the rest of the run.

flavor.description: Optional size name (list_flavors). Omit it and the platform sizes the machine for the run.

keypair_name.description: Optional: an SSH keypair of your account (list_keypairs) added to the machine's authorized keys.

run_id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.

user_data.description: Optional setup the machine applies when it is handed over: a #cloud-config with write_files and runcmd (other keys are refused), or a #! script. Runs as root.

name: start_machine
title: Start machine in run
